user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point layer into the census tract coordinate reference system so the spatial join uses compatible CRS inputs.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject input_1 from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26918 without changing its records or attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and retain the hospital attributes together with the tract identifier.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join using hospitals_projected as the hospital point layer and input_2 as the census tract polygon layer. Match each hospital to the tract that contains its point, retain the hospital attributes, and append the tract GEOID as the tract identifier.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.
